lines.text: It's a warm June morning in Banff town, so Jake heads up to Lake Agnes in trail runners.
An hour later, he's sinking into deep snow.
Higher trails in the Rockies can stay snowy into July.
For thawed lakes and open trails, plan late June to mid-September.
Check Parks Canada trail conditions first, and pack for winter up high.
Jake returns in August. Dry feet.
Save this before you plan Banff.
